anchor: Plan v26 Phase B.1 — top-200 cities for Margin Atlas neighborhood expansion. Balanced across continents per founder direction: ~30 NA, ~50 EU, ~60 Asia, ~20 SA, ~15 Africa, ~10 Oceania, ~15 MENA. Tier 1 = top 20 mega-metros (deepest neighborhood breakdown). Tier 2 = next 50 major metros (neighborhood breakdown). Tier 3 = remaining 130 (city-level only). Includes wealth-concentrated micros (Monaco, Vaduz) but excludes pure tax-haven shells with no real local economy (Bermuda, Cayman, BVI).
convention: slug = URL slug. iso2 = ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 country code. continent ∈ {NA, EU, Asia, SA, Africa, Oceania, MENA}. tier ∈ {1, 2, 3}. pop_m = approximate metro population (millions). gdp_b = approximate metro GDP (billions USD, 2024). wealth_z = z-score of metro GDP per capita vs global median (rough). Source: cross-reference of public city statistics; not authoritative but consistent.
